title: Flame Design per-test conditions (conditions only)
description: Every test point in the two PSI-10 experimental tables. These tables record conditions only: no ignition, burn time, flame size, soot or extinction outcome is present, and none is inferred.

sources.path: ACME Flame Design/PSI-10_Experimental table_Flame Design_Normal Flame.csv
ACME Flame Design/PSI-10_Experimental table_Flame Design_Inverse Flame.csv

field_specs.variable: Fuel (normal flames from burner; inverse: C2H4 in the ambient)
Fuel mole fraction in burner supply (normal)
Ambient O2 mole fraction, final (normal; post-test)
O2 mole fraction in burner supply (inverse)
Ambient C2H4 mole fraction, final (inverse; post-test)
Mean pressure converted for comparison with CFI-G
RAMP / RAMPED / LOW O2 marker (no single flow value)

notes: Pressure is in atm here and in bar in CFI-G; comparisons convert explicitly (1 atm = 1.01325 bar).
Rows marked RAMP/RAMPED/LOW O2 have no single flow value and are excluded from condition-space plots, not deleted.
